sources.note: Reverse engineering help page; WebFetch extraction (paraphrase)

claims.statement: A unique column referencing another PK yields @OneToOne with @JoinColumn on the owner and @OneToOne(mappedBy) on the other entity.
claims.supports: unique constraint ... @OneToOne with @JoinColumn; other entity @OneToOne with mappedBy
claims.ourFeature: Generate entities from SQL file… (ddl_entities_action.rs, ddl_parse.rs)

claims.statement: A PK that is also an FK yields a basic @Id plus an association with @MapsId, optional=false and non-nullable @JoinColumn.
claims.supports: primary key is also a foreign key: @MapsId, optional = false, non-nullable @JoinColumn
claims.ourFeature: Generate entities from SQL file… (ddl_entities_action.rs, ddl_parse.rs)

claims.statement: A column referencing another PK yields @ManyToOne+@JoinColumn on the many side and @OneToMany(mappedBy) with a LinkedHashSet Set on the one side.
claims.supports: @OneToMany(mappedBy) with a Set initialized to LinkedHashSet; @ManyToOne with @JoinColumn
claims.ourFeature: Generate entities from SQL file… (ddl_entities_action.rs, ddl_parse.rs)

claims.statement: A junction table with only two FK columns yields @ManyToMany with @JoinTable on one side and mappedBy on the other.
claims.supports: junction table contains only two foreign key columns ... @JoinTable ... mappedBy
claims.ourFeature: Generate entities from SQL file… (ddl_entities_action.rs, ddl_parse.rs)

claims.statement: References can be shown even when the current table has no matching column.
claims.supports: can show references even when the current table has no matching column
claims.ourFeature: Generate entities from SQL file… (ddl_entities_action.rs, ddl_parse.rs)
claims.surfaceEquivalent: Generating entities from a SQL file always adds the inverse side of a foreign key (@OneToMany(mappedBy) on the referenced entity) although its table has no matching column. Not checked: the dialog's References group and per-reference choice.
